title: New Budget Proposal & Public Input Set
summary:
*   The City Manager presented the proposed budget for the upcoming 1995-96 fiscal year.
*   A resolution was approved to formally acknowledge receipt of the proposed budget.
*   A public hearing was set for August 17, 1995, at 5:00 p.m. to gather public input on the new budget proposal.
transcript:
TY OF AUSTIN
FOUNDED 1839
Austin City Council
MINUTES
SPECIAL CALLED MEETING
July 26, 1995
Mayor Todd called the meeting to order, Councilmembers Shea and Mitchell temporarily out
of the room, Councilmember Nofziger absent.
PREVIEW OF ITEMS FOR NEXT COUNCIL MEETING 1. Review of Proposed Agenda Items from City
Manager for August 3, 1995.
2. Review of Proposed Agenda Items from Council for August 3, 1995. BRIEFINGS AND
DISCUSSIONS 3. Presentation of City Manager's Proposed FY 1995-96 Budget.
Presentation made by City Manager Jesus Garza.
4. Approve a resolution acknowledging receipt of the City Manager's proposed FY 1995-96
Budget; set a public hearing on the proposed budget. (Suggested date and time: August 17,
1995 at 5:00 p.m.
Approved on Councilmember Shea's motion, Mayor Pro Tem Garcia's second, 6-0 vote,
Councilmember Nofziger absent.
ADJOURNED at 2:35 p.m., on Councilmember Shea's motion, Mayor Pro Tem Garcia's second, 6-0
vote, Councilmember Nofziger absent.
Approved on this the 3rd day of August, 1995, on Councilmember Goodman's motion, Mayor Pro
Tem Garcia's second, 5-0 vote, Councilmember Shea off the dais, Mayor Todd absent.
